དང: and; with · after a verb: 'as soon as' (brgyal bsangs pa dang 'as soon as the faint has cleared')
ལ: to, at, in, for; after a verb or adjective: 'and' · among (… kyi rigs la 'among those of the … kind') · on (… la bzhugs 'seated on …')
སེམས་མ: female bodhisattva (sems ma, short for sems dpa' ma)
ཀྱིས: by, by means of (the 'of' particle + -s; the form used after d, b, s) · after a verb: 'but, and', running on to what follows (yod kyis 'there is, but') · in this print also written where kyi 'of' is meant (sangs rgyas kyis sku, read 'the buddha's bodies')
བསྐོར: surrounded, encircled (bskor, past of skor 'to surround, to circle')
ནས: from; after a verb: 'having done, and then'
ཀྱི: of (the form used after d, b, s; also gyi, gi, -'i, yi)
དྲུག་ཏུ: among six, as six (drug 'six' + -tu 'among, as'): rigs drug tu 'among the six kinds'; sku drug tu 'as six bodies'
འཆར་དུ: to dawn, to arise ('char 'dawn, arise' + -du 'to'): 'char du 'ong 'will dawn'
ཕུང་པོ: mass, heap (phung po) · aggregate, one of the five that make up a person (phung po; Sanskrit skandha)
གནས་སུ: in its place, in the place (gnas 'place' + -su 'in') · into the place of (… gnas su ltung 'fall into the abode of …')
བྱ་བ: called; what is to be done (bya, future of byed 'do', + ba). zhes bya ba: 'so called'
གྲུབ་པའི: of the established (grub pa 'established' + -'i 'of') · formed from, made of (… las grub pa'i 'formed from …')
ཡེ་ཤེས: wisdom, primordial knowing (ye 'from the first' + shes 'know'; Sanskrit jñāna)
ཉམས་ང་བ: fearsome, awesome (nyams nga ba, the print's spelling of nyam nga ba)
ཐིག་ལེ: drop, sphere, point of light (thig le)
གྱིས: do! (imperative of byed 'to do'); spelled the same as gyis 'by' · by (the 'by' ending as a free word after n, m, r, l): las bzang ngan gyis 'by good or bad karma'
ཅིག: one, a (gcig written without its prefix g-)
དོན་ཡོད་གྲུབ་པ: Amoghasiddhi, 'He Whose Aim Is Accomplished' (don yod 'not in vain' + grub pa 'accomplished'): the buddha of the north and of the fifth day
ཡབ་ཡུམ: father and mother; a buddha and his consort in union (yab 'father' + yum 'mother')
གྱི: of (the form used after n, m, r, l)
ཐུགས་ཀ: heart, chest (thugs ka), the respectful word
གི: of (the form used after g, ng); in this print also written where gis 'by' is meant · after a verb: 'and', running on to what follows ('ong gi 'comes, and')
སྙིང: heart (snying); snying mi dga' 'the heart not glad', sad
ཐད་ཀར: straight at, level with (thad ka 'straight toward' + -r): snying gi thad kar 'at the level of the heart'
གིས: by (the form used after g, ng) · after a verb: 'and', running on to what follows, as gi does ('ong gis 'comes, and')
བཟོད་པ: bearing, endurance (bzod 'bear, endure' + -pa): mi bzod pa 'unbearable'
ཙམ་དུ: just so far, just to the point of (tsam + du)
ཟུག: to pierce, to stab, to stick in (zug)
དེ: that; he, it. After a verb (also te, ste): 'and then'
མ: not (before past and imperative verbs) · in a prohibition also before the present stem: ma byed cig 'do not do!'
འཇིགས་པར: in fear, afraid ('jigs pa 'fear' + -r): ma 'jigs par 'without fear, not fearing'
བྱར་མེད: with nothing to do, effortless (bya, future stem of byed 'do', 'to be done', + -r + med 'there is not')
ངང་དུ: in the state, in the condition (ngang 'state, nature' + -du 'in')
ཞོག་ཅིག: leave it! rest! (zhog, imperative of 'jog 'to put, to leave', + cig, which marks a command)
ལྷ་མ་ཡིན: demigod, asura (lha ma yin 'not-god'): a being who wars with the gods out of envy
ཕྲག་དོག: jealousy, envy (phrag dog): the mind's poison of the fifth day
ལས: from, out of · karma, action (las): las kyi 'of karma'; after a verb or noun, 'other than, of, from among'
གྲུབ་པ: established, proved to exist (grub 'be established' + -pa); ma grub pa 'not established as anything'
ཀྱང: also, even, though (the form of yang after g, d, b, s)
འོང་བས: because it comes, since it will come ('ong 'come' + -bas, the print's spelling of -pas 'because')
དགའ་བར: with delight, gladly (dga' 'glad, delight' + -bar, making an adverb): dga' bar byed 'take delight'
བྱེད་ཅིག: do (byed, the present stem of byed 'do', + cig, which marks a command): with ma, a prohibition, ma byed cig 'do not do!' (the imperative of byed is gyis)
དྲག་པོས: by the fierce, by the strong (drag po 'fierce' + -s 'by')
མཚེར་བ: shimmering (the print's spelling, read as 'tsher ba; mtsher is no known word)
བྲོས་སུ: fleeing, in flight (bros, past of 'bros 'to flee', + -su): bros su 'ong 'will flee'
འོང: comes, happens, it may happen that ('ong 'come')
ཞིང: and, while: links one verb to the next (zhing, the form used after a vowel and after ng, n, m, r, l, '; also cing, shing)
ཆགས་སེམས: a mind of attachment, desire (chags 'be attached' + sems 'mind')
སྐྱེས: arisen, born (skyes, past of skye 'be born, arise')
དེ་ཙ་ན: at that time, then (de 'that' + tsa na; a set phrase)
ཡེ་ཤེས་སུ: as wisdom (ye shes 'wisdom' + -su 'as'): ye shes su ngo shes 'recognise as wisdom'
ངོ: face; the nature or identity of a thing
གྱིས་ཤིག: do! (gyis, imperative of byed 'do', + shig, which marks a command)
རིག་པ: knowing, awareness itself, before any thought
བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས: the Blessed One, a title of a buddha (bcom ldan 'das, Sanskrit bhagavān; 'das 'gone beyond')
དོན་ཡོད་གྲུབ་པའི: of Amoghasiddhi (don yod 'not in vain' + grub pa 'accomplished' + -'i 'of')
སྐྱབས་སུ: for refuge, as refuge (skyabs 'refuge' + -su 'to'): skyabs su mchi'o 'I go for refuge'
མཆིའོ: I go (mchi, the humble 'go', + the sentence-ending -'o)
ཐོབ་ཅིག: uncertain; perhaps 'obtain!' (thob 'obtain, get' + cig, which marks a command); gsol ba thob cig gives no clear sense, and is read, as a guess, 'make the prayer'
ནི: as for: marks the topic of the sentence
ཞེས: so, thus: closes a quotation or a name (like inverted commas)
འཇིགས་ཤིག: be afraid! ('jigs 'fear' + shig, which marks a command); ma 'jigs shig 'do not be afraid'
ཆགས་པར: in being attached, attached (chags pa + -r): chags par byed 'be attached'
བསགས་པའི: of what is gathered, which has been gathered (bsags 'gather, pile up', past of gsog, + -pa'i 'of'): a clause placed before its noun
ན: if, when (after the verb); also 'in, at' · to be ill, sickness (na, the verb of na ba): skye rga na 'chi 'birth, ageing, sickness and death'
གླགས: opportunity, chance (glags): bzod glags med pa 'with no chance to bear it', unbearable
མྱོང: to experience, to suffer, to undergo (myong)
སྟེ: and, namely: a linking word after a verb or a statement, leading on to what follows (also te, de)
ཐར་ལམ: path to liberation (thar 'liberation' + lam 'path'), shortened from thar pa'i lam
བཀག་པའི: of what has blocked, that blocks (bkag, past stem of 'gog 'to block', + -pa'i 'of'): a clause placed before its noun
སྤོངས་ཤིག: give up! (spongs, imperative of spong 'give up', + shig, which marks a command)
ཞེན་ཅིག: cling! (zhen 'cling' + cig, which marks a command); ma zhen cig 'do not cling'
རྩེ་གཅིག་ཏུ: one-pointedly, with a single mind (rtse 'point, tip' + gcig 'one' + -tu)
གཏོད: to direct, to aim at, to set upon (gtod): 'dun pa gtod 'direct a longing'
འདི་སྐད་དུ: in these words, thus ('di 'this' + skad 'speech, words' + -du 'in')
ཀྱཻ་མ: alas! a cry of lament or entreaty at the head of a prayer (kyai ma, the same cry as kye ma)
འཁོར་བར: in saṃsāra, in the round ('khor ba 'the round, saṃsāra' + -r 'in')
གསལ་བའི: making clear, of clarity (gsal ba 'clear, to be clear' + -'i 'of')
བཅོམ་ལྡན: Blessed One, a title of a buddha (bcom ldan, short for bcom ldan 'das)
ལམ་སྣ: head of the road, the way ahead (lam 'path' + sna 'front, head'): lam sna drongs 'lead the way'
ཡུམ: mother; a buddha's female partner, consort (yum)
སྐྱོར: to hold up, to support (skyor, the present stem, which also serves as the imperative 'hold up!'; past and future bskyor)
བར་དོ: the between: the interval between two states, above all between death and rebirth (bar 'between' + do 'two')
འཕྲང: narrow passage, defile, a dangerous place on a road ('phrang)
བསྒྲལ་དུ: to free, to deliver (bsgral, future stem of sgrol 'to free', + -du): bsgral du gsol 'I pray that you free'
གསོལ: to pray, to ask, to request (gsol, the humble word for 'ask'): -du gsol 'I ask that'
ཡང་དག: true, genuine, perfect (yang dag): yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'true and perfect buddha' (Sanskrit samyaksaṃbuddha)
ས་རུ: to the level, to the stage (sa 'ground, level' + -ru 'to'): the stage a buddha has reached
སྐྱོལ: bring! deliver! (skyol, imperative of skyel 'to bring, to convey')
བཏབ་པས: by having given, because it is given (btab pa + -s 'by')
ཐུགས་ཀར: in the heart, into the heart (thugs ka 'heart', respectful, + -r 'in, into')
འཇའ་འོད་དུ: as rainbow light, into rainbow light ('ja' 'rainbow' + 'od 'light' + -du 'as, into')
ཞིང་ཁམས་སུ: in the realm, in the buddha-field (zhing khams 'realm' + -su 'in')
ལོངས་སྤྱོད་རྫོགས་པའི་སྐུར: as the body of perfect enjoyment (longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku + -r 'as')
སངས་རྒྱས་པར: to being a buddha, as a buddha (sangs rgyas 'buddha' + -pa + -r 'to'): sangs rgyas par 'gyur 'become a buddha'
འགྱུར་རོ: becomes, will become ('gyur 'to become, to change' + the sentence-ending -ro)
རིམ་བ: order, succession, stage (rim ba, the print's spelling of rim pa): rim ba ltar 'in order'
ངོ་སྤྲད་པས: by being pointed out (ngo sprad 'point out' + -pa + -s 'by')
ཡང: also, even, though (written kyang after g, d, b, s) · again, once more, at the head of a sentence (yang ngo sprad pa ni 'and the pointing out again')
ཟིན: seized, caught; held (zin, the intransitive verb beside 'dzin 'to hold'): ngos zin 'recognise'
ཏེ: and, and so: links a verb to what follows (te, the form of ste after n, r, l; this print also writes it after other letters)
འཕྲོད: to meet, to be received (ngo 'phrod: 'the face is met', to recognise)
གྲོལ: to be freed, to come free
སྲིད་དོ: can be, is possible (srid 'be possible' + the sentence-ending -do): mi srid 'it cannot be, it is impossible'
ངོ་སྤྲད: pointing out, face-introduction (ngo sprad, past of ngo sprod 'point out')
བག་ཆགས: habitual tendencies, the traces past actions leave in the mind (bag chags; Sanskrit vāsanā)
ཡུན་རིང: long time, a long duration (yun 'duration' + ring 'long')
ཁྲིད: guidance, a lama's step-by-step instruction in practice
ཟིན་པར: seizing, holding (zin + -par): zin par the tshom med 'no doubt that (they) will seize it' · caught, held (zin pa + -r): mi zin par 'without being caught'
ཟེར: say, call (zer 'say, speak') · ray, ray of light (zer), as in 'od zer, and sgra 'od zer gsum 'sound, light and rays'
དངངས་སྐྲག: dread and terror (dngangs, the print's spelling of sngangs 'dread', + skrag 'be frightened')
མར: down, downward (mar, the opposite of yar 'up'); of time, 'on, onward' · butter (mar), another word of the same spelling
འཆར: to dawn, to arise, to appear
ངོ་སྤྲད་པ: pointed out, the pointing out (ngo sprad, past of ngo sprod, + pa)
ཚེ་འདས: one whose life has passed, the dead person (tshe 'life' + 'das 'gone beyond')
འདི་སྐད་དོ: these words (are said) ('di 'this' + skad 'speech' + the sentence-ending -do)
ཀྱཻ: O! a call for attention (also written kye)
རིགས་ཀྱི་བུ: child of the family, child of noble family (rigs 'family' + kyi 'of' + bu 'son, child'; Sanskrit kulaputra)
ཕན་ཆད: up to, until, as far as (phan chad)
སྣང་བ: appearance, what appears to the senses or the mind; light
འདིར: here, in this ('di + -r 'in') · in 'dir btsam du, as printed, perhaps for ldir 'roaring' (ldir ba tsam du 'as loud as the roaring of'); a guess
རང་མདངས: own radiance, natural glow (rang 'self' + mdangs 'radiance, glow')
རྣམས: plural marker, set after the noun and its adjectives
ཤེས: to know, to recognise (shes); ngo shes 'recognise, know the face'
ལོངས་སྤྱོད་རྫོགས་པའི་སྐུ་རུ: as the body of perfect enjoyment (longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'body of perfect enjoyment', the radiant form in which a buddha appears in visions, + -ru 'as')
ཡེངས་པར: distractedly, in distraction (yengs pa 'to be distracted' + -r): ma yengs par 'undistracted'
ཉོན་ཅིག: listen! (nyon, imperative of nyan 'listen', + cig, which marks a command)
བསུ་བ: meeting, welcoming, going out to meet someone (bsu 'to meet, welcome' + -ba); bsu ba la 'ongs 'come to meet'
འབྱུང་བ: element, one of the five of which the world is made: earth, water, fire, wind, space ('byung ba, literally 'what arises') · arising, coming about ('byung 'arise' + -ba)
བཞིའི: of four (bzhi 'four' + -'i 'of'); zhag phyed dang bzhi 'three and a half days'
རྣམ་པར: completely, in every way (rnam par): rnam par dag pa 'completely pure'
དབུས་ཕྱོགས: the centre, the central quarter (dbus 'centre' + phyogs 'direction, side')
ཐིག་ལེ་བརྡལ་བའི: of the Spreading Drop, the name of Vairocana's realm (thig le 'drop, sphere' + brdal 'spread out' + -ba'i 'of')
རྣམ་པར་སྣང་མཛད: Vairocana, 'He Who Makes Appear in Every Way' (rnam par 'in every way' + snang 'appear' + mdzad, respectful 'do, make'); the buddha of the centre
གོང: above, before, earlier (gong 'above'); gong gi 'the one above'
མངོན་པར་དགའ་བའི: of Manifest Joy (mngon par 'manifestly' + dga' ba 'joy' + -'i 'of'; Sanskrit Abhirati): the buddha-field of the east
རྡོ་རྗེ་སེམས་དཔའ: Vajrasattva, 'Vajra Being' (rdo rje 'vajra' + sems dpa' 'hero of mind'; Sanskrit vajrasattva): the buddha of the second day, here the same figure as Akṣobhya
ལྡན་པའི: of the endowed, endowed with (ldan pa 'having' + -'i 'of'): dpal dang ldan pa'i 'endowed with glory'
རིན་ཆེན་འབྱུང་ལྡན: Source of Jewels (rin chen 'jewel, precious thing' + 'byung ldan 'having arising'; Sanskrit Ratnasambhava): the buddha of the south and of the third day
བདེ་བ་ཅན: the Blissful, Sukhāvatī, the buddha-field of the west (bde ba 'bliss' + can 'having')
སྣང་བ་མཐའ་ཡས: Boundless Appearance, Boundless Light: the buddha Amitābha (snang ba 'appearance, light' + mtha' yas 'without limit')
ཡི་དྭགས: hungry ghost (yi dwags; Sanskrit preta), a being tormented by hunger and thirst
ཀུན་ཏུ་བཟང་པོ: the All-Good, Samantabhadra, the male buddha who stands for clear awareness (kun tu 'in every way' + bzang 'good' + -po, masculine) · also the bodhisattva of that name (Samantabhadra), one of the eight great bodhisattvas
ཀུན་ཏུ་བཟང་མོ: the All-Good Lady, Samantabhadrī, the female buddha who stands for reality as empty (kun tu 'in every way' + bzang 'good' + -mo, feminine)
ནང: inside, within (nang): 'od kyi nang nas 'from within the light'
ཡོད་པ: having, there being; one who has (yod 'there is' + -pa)
ཕྱིར: outside, outward(?). The reading is uncertain; another print has dri med, 'stainless', here · here plainly 'out, outward' (phyi 'outside' + -r): phyir log 'turn back out', phyir thon 'come out'
འོང་བ: coming (the present stem 'ong 'come' + -ba): 'ong ba yin no 'is coming'
ཡེ་ནས: at all, ever (with a negative: 'not at all')
ཡིན་པར: that it is, as being (yin pa 'being' + -r 'as, that'): X yin par shes 'know that it is X'
